spans.text: ...In the underground base.
Intense gunfire echoes through the synthesis lab.
The three Dolls of the AR Team each take one direction, forming a protective circle around the Commander and Dandelion.
Tsk. Amazing.
The Commander is one thing, but why do we have to drag around a millstone like you?!
...You can always give me your gun.
I don't mind demonstrating my abilities.
Enough!
...They were prepared for us, so they must have factored Dandelion into their plans.
We've been too reliant on her.
We've almost forgotten that there are no shortcuts in battle.
There's too many of them!
...We won't be able to go back the way we came.
Now that comms have been cut, we need to think of another way to contact Squad Griffin.
...You don't need to worry about that.
They'll definitely be able to find us.
What makes you so sure?
I just know.
Commander, you should study up on some historical tactics when you get the chance. The classics never go out of style.
What are you talking about?
Commander, we can fall back to the research block, then detour around to reach the main corridor.
Are you sure?
Don't look down on me.
Even if my external connections have been jammed, my computational efficiency is as high as ever.
"15, you must learn to trust your friends."
Do you HAVE to make trouble at a time like this?!
Commander, the enemy's about to break through our line of defense!
We can hold out for 30 seconds tops!
Commander!
We have no choice.
Get ready to fall back to six o'clock! We're moving toward the research block!
Ugh...
Where is this place...?
In the dark, cramped room, Machlian gets up, pulls out the needles that are still drawing her blood, and tries to climb off the machine weakly.
Oh no...
Robin... Robin!
Suddenly remembering the Commander, Machlian rolls off the side of the machine and struggles to get back to her feet.
The synthesized serum is deposited inside a culture tank. It appears the apparatus is still performing its original function.
The problem is the new function that has obviously been programmed into it.
I need...to find...Robin.
Clutching the serum to her chest, Machlian searches through her memories and rushes out barefoot.
